problem: A farmer keeps 9 eggs in her kitchen. She then collects 3 baskets from the hen house with 7 eggs in each basket. How many eggs does she have now?
follow_up_questions: She bakes cakes that need 6 eggs each. How many cakes can she bake?
Every cake is cut into 4 slices. How many slices are there?
If 17 slices are eaten at the picnic, how many slices remain?

problem: How many crayons does Mr. Novak end up with? He starts the morning with 9 loose crayons, then opens 3 new packs that hold 7 crayons apiece.
follow_up_questions: He puts 6 crayons on each desk. How many desks get crayons?
Each desk seats 4 children. How many children will have crayons to use?
Only 17 children turn up today. How many of the places with crayons stay empty?

problem: A pet shelter buys 4 boxes holding 25 cans of dog food each. The dogs eat 18 cans every day for 5 days. How many cans remain?
Find how many seed packets the garden club still has. Over 5 weekends, members planted 18 packets each weekend, and the club had started with 4 cartons of 25 packets.
For sports day, a coach fills 9 coolers with 7 juice boxes in each. After 48 runners each take 1 juice box, how many juice boxes are still in the coolers?
follow_up_questions: Then 6 parent helpers take 2 juice boxes each. How many juice boxes remain now?

problem: How many stickers are left in the art room? The teacher filled 9 envelopes with 7 stickers apiece, and 48 pupils each took 1 sticker.
follow_up_questions: Later, 6 classroom helpers took 2 stickers each. How many stickers are left after that?

problem: At the book fair a storybook costs 9 dollars. Amara buys 3 storybooks and a bookmark for 2 dollars. How much does she spend?
follow_up_questions: She pays with 40 dollars. What change does she get?
Her 2 cousins each give her the money for one storybook. How much do the cousins pay her altogether?

problem: What is the bill at the garden centre? One plant pot costs 9 dollars, and Mr. Ruiz takes 3 pots plus a 2-dollar bag of soil.
follow_up_questions: If he gives the cashier 40 dollars, how much comes back to him?
His 2 neighbours each pay him for one pot. How much money do they hand him together?

problem: Grandma sewed 15 patches for the family quilt, and her 4 grandchildren sewed 12 patches each. The quilt took 3 weeks to finish. How many patches were sewn in all?
follow_up_questions: The quilt needs 90 patches altogether. How many more patches must be sewn?

problem: How many cookies have been decorated so far? At the bake sale table, 4 volunteers iced 12 cookies apiece, and the organiser iced 15 on her own. The sale opens at 9 o'clock.
follow_up_questions: They want 90 decorated cookies for the sale. How many more still need icing?

problem: In the art room, 3 tables each made 8 paper lanterns, and the art teacher made 6 more. Glitter covered the floor by the end. How many lanterns were made?
follow_up_questions: The lanterns are hung on 5 strings with the same number on each. How many lanterns are on one string?
Next, 2 lanterns fall off every string. How many are still on one string?
How many lanterns are still hanging on all the strings together?

problem: How many cupcakes did the baking club make? Its 3 teams baked 8 cupcakes each, and the club leader added 6 of her own. The kitchen smelled of vanilla all afternoon.
follow_up_questions: They set the cupcakes out on 5 plates, sharing them equally. How many cupcakes are on each plate?
Visitors then eat 2 cupcakes from every plate. How many are left on one plate?
Altogether, how many cupcakes remain on the plates?

problem: A zoo keeper starts the day with 64 fish in a bucket. Each of the 7 penguins gets 4 fish at breakfast and 2 at supper. How many fish remain at the end of the day?
follow_up_questions: A van delivers 3 crates with 25 fish in each. How many fish are there now?
Compared with the start of the day, how many more fish are there now?

problem: How many carrots are left in the barn after one day? The farm has 64 carrots, and its 7 rabbits are each fed 4 carrots in the morning and 2 in the evening.
follow_up_questions: Then the farmer brings in 3 sacks holding 25 carrots each. What is the number of carrots in the barn now?
How many more carrots are there now than there were at first?

problem: Stickers are sold in sheets of 20. A teacher gives each of her 15 students 4 stickers. How many sheets does she use up?
At the birthday party, 15 children each received 4 balloons. If balloons come in packets of 20, how many packets were opened?

At the school fair, Ayesha ran the snack table with her aunt. She sold 23 bags of popcorn for 3 dollars each and 18 cartons of juice for 2 dollars each. The fair had 14 stalls in all. How much money did the snack table make?
follow_up_questions: Her aunt had paid 45 dollars for the snacks that morning. How much is left after paying that back?

problem: How much did the bookshop take in on Saturday? It sold 23 comic books at 3 dollars each and 18 bookmarks at 2 dollars each. The shop has stood on the corner for 30 years.
follow_up_questions: The owner spent 45 dollars on new shelves that week. How much of Saturday's money is left once that is covered?

problem: Noor baked muffins for the bake sale. She filled 4 trays, each with 8 muffins, and sold 19 before noon. How many muffins were still for sale?
follow_up_questions: Later she sold 9 more. How many muffins did she sell that day altogether?
Each muffin cost 2 dollars. How much money did Noor make that day?

problem: What is the number of seed bags still unsold at the garden stall? Mr. Petrov packed 4 crates of 8 bags, then customers bought 19 of them in the morning.
follow_up_questions: After lunch, 9 more bags were bought. How many bags were sold over the whole day?
Every bag cost 2 dollars. What did he earn for the day?

problem: At the outdoor concert, 12 rows of 15 folding chairs were set up on the lawn. When the music began, only 27 chairs were empty. How many people were sitting?
follow_up_questions: At the second concert, 18 more people sat down than at the first. How many people were seated at the second concert?

problem: How many guests came to the wedding? The hall was arranged with 15 chairs in each of 12 rows, and 27 chairs were left unused.
follow_up_questions: A second party there had 18 more guests than the wedding. How many guests came to the second party?

problem: The football club sells raffle tickets in strips of 10. Coach Rivera sold 14 strips and also 9 single tickets. What was the number of tickets sold?
follow_up_questions: One ticket costs 3 dollars. How much did the coach collect?
He used 85 dollars of it to buy new nets. How much money is left?

problem: How many stamps does Kofi own? He has 14 full sheets, each with 10 stamps, plus 9 loose stamps kept in an envelope.
follow_up_questions: A collector offers 3 dollars per stamp. How much would Kofi get for all of them?
If Kofi spends 85 dollars of that on a new album, how much remains?

problem: A small theatre puts on a puppet show for children every Sunday. The theatre has 9 rows, and each row has 12 seats. Last Sunday the show lasted 50 minutes and 14 seats were not taken. How many people watched?
follow_up_questions: Tickets were 4 dollars each. How much money did the theatre collect for that show?
It cost 90 dollars to pay the puppeteers. How much money remained?
The next Sunday, twice as many seats stayed empty. How many people watched the show then?

problem: Find how many passengers rode the tour boat on its 3 o'clock trip. The boat has 9 benches with 12 places on each bench, and 14 places were empty on that trip.
follow_up_questions: Each passenger paid 4 dollars. How much did the boat earn on that trip?
The captain spent 90 dollars on fuel. What was left of the money after that?
On the next trip, double the number of places were empty. How many passengers rode then?

problem: A school garden has 6 flower beds. The gardeners need 8 bags of soil for each bed and 15 more bags for the pumpkin patch. How many bags of soil must they buy?
follow_up_questions: The soil is delivered in trailers carrying 9 bags each. How many trailers will come?

problem: How many tins of paint should the decorators order? They are painting 6 classrooms that need 8 tins each, and the long hallway needs 15 tins as well.
follow_up_questions: The tins come in crates of 9. How many crates is that?

problem: At the beach, Rafael and his sisters made 4 sandcastles and put 3 shells on top of each one. A seagull kept trying to steal their sandwiches. They had gathered 26 shells. How many shells were left?
follow_up_questions: Then they pushed 2 more shells into the side of each sandcastle as windows. How many shells are left now?
A lifeguard gave them 9 more shells he had found. How many shells do they have now?

problem: How many buttons did Grandma have left over? She had 26 buttons in her sewing tin and sewed 3 onto each of 4 new cardigans. Her cat curled up on the wool while she worked.
follow_up_questions: She then added 2 more buttons to every cardigan for the pockets. How many buttons are left now?
Her friend brought over 9 buttons. How many buttons are in the tin now?

problem: A bag held 72 marbles. Coach Amina and her 2 helpers each took 18 marbles for a game. How many marbles were left in the bag?
follow_up_questions: Later the three of them shared the marbles left in the bag equally. How many more marbles did each person get?

problem: How many pages of the photo album still had no pictures? The album had 72 pages, and on a snowy afternoon Aunt Rosa and her 2 nephews each filled 18 pages.
follow_up_questions: The next day the three of them split the empty pages evenly. How many pages did each of them fill?

problem: The art club is making paper kites for the spring festival. Each of its 13 members will make 2 kites, and every kite needs 4 ribbon tails. The festival is in 9 days. How many ribbon tails must the members cut?
follow_up_questions: The tails are cut from rolls of ribbon, 8 tails from each roll. How many rolls do they need?
At the festival, 5 kites would not fly. How many kites flew?
Each kite that flew won the club 3 points. What was the club's score?

problem: How many wheels must the toy workshop make? Its 13 volunteers are each building 2 wooden cars, and every car needs 4 wheels. The workshop opened 7 years ago.
follow_up_questions: The wheels are cut from wooden boards, 8 wheels per board. How many boards are needed?
During testing, 5 of the cars broke. How many cars still work?
Each working car is sold for 3 dollars. How much money do they make?

problem: A furniture workshop had 64 table legs in its storeroom. This week the carpenters made 7 tables, using 4 legs on each. How many legs are left in the storeroom?
follow_up_questions: How many more tables with 4 legs can be made from the legs that remain?
Adding the tables made this week, how many tables will the workshop have made in total?

problem: What number of wheels does the skate shop still have? It started with 64 wheels and built 7 skateboards this week, each with 4 wheels.
follow_up_questions: How many more skateboards with 4 wheels can be built from the leftover wheels?
Together with this week's skateboards, how many skateboards would the shop have built?

problem: Chef Alvarez is baking pies for the village picnic. She bought 7 boxes of apples with a dozen apples in each box, and every pie takes 3 apples. The picnic tables were covered in checked cloths. What is the largest number of pies she can bake?
How many bracelets can the craft club make at most? The club has 7 packets of charms with 12 charms in each packet, and one bracelet gets 3 charms. Everyone wanted the purple ones.
Mr. Kowalski is decorating cakes for a party that begins at 4 o'clock. He puts 6 cherries on each of 7 small cakes and 9 cherries on the big cake. How many cherries does he use?
follow_up_questions: He started with a bowl of 70 cherries. How many cherries are left in the bowl?

problem: How many beads will Amaya thread for the craft market? She is making 7 necklaces with 6 beads on each and one anklet with 9 beads. The market stall costs 20 dollars to rent.
follow_up_questions: Her jar holds 70 beads. How many will be left in the jar?

problem: At the zoo kiosk, bottles of water cost 3 dollars and sandwiches cost 5 dollars. On Sunday it sold 46 bottles of water and 38 sandwiches. How much money did the kiosk take?
follow_up_questions: On Monday it sold twice as many bottles of water as on Sunday. How much did the water bring in on Monday?
It also sold 12 fewer sandwiches on Monday than on Sunday. How many sandwiches were sold over the two days?

problem: What did the bakery earn from bread? On Friday it sold 46 small rolls for 3 dollars each and 38 big loaves for 5 dollars each.
follow_up_questions: On Saturday the bakery sold double the number of small rolls. How much did the rolls bring in on Saturday?
Saturday's loaf sales were 12 lower than Friday's. Over the two days, how many big loaves were sold?

problem: There are 28 people on the tour bus. When it stops, half of them go into the museum shop and 5 of the others go to the cafe. The rest stay on the bus. How many people stay on the bus?
Find how many books are left for the reading corner. A teacher has 28 new books; she puts half of them on the library shelf and gives 5 of the remaining ones to another class.
The farmers are building 6 new pens for the goats, and each pen needs 14 fence posts. So far, 50 posts have arrived. How many more posts are needed?
follow_up_questions: The remaining posts arrive in trailers that carry 17 posts each. How many trailer loads are needed?

problem: How many more bricks does the gardener need? She is edging 6 flower beds that take 14 bricks each, and she already has 50 bricks.
follow_up_questions: The missing bricks come in wheelbarrow loads of 17. How many loads is that?

problem: The boat hire at the lake had 16 rowing boats. On a sunny morning, which reached 28 degrees, each boat was hired 3 times, and each hire cost 4 dollars. How much did the boat hire earn?
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon there were 25 more hires at the same price. How much did the boat hire earn for the whole day?

problem: What did the pony rides earn before lunch? At the farm show, 16 children each rode 3 times, and every ride cost 4 dollars. The farm keeps 12 ponies.
follow_up_questions: After lunch there were 25 more rides at the same price. What did the pony rides earn for the day?

problem: The art class is visiting the museum. A ticket costs 7 dollars for each of the 15 children and 9 dollars for each of the 3 adults with them. Everyone was excited to see the dinosaur bones. What is the total cost of the tickets?
What will the swimming club pay for the water park? Each of the 15 swimmers needs a 7-dollar ticket, and each of the 3 coaches needs a 9-dollar ticket. It was the sunniest day of the summer.
At the dance show, each of the 8 groups performs for 45 minutes. There is also a 20-minute interval halfway through. How many minutes do the performances and the interval take in total?
follow_up_questions: Setting up takes another 40 minutes. How many hours does the whole show last?

problem: How many minutes of oven time does the baking contest need? Every one of the 8 bakers gets 45 minutes in the oven, and the oven needs a 20-minute clean during the day.
follow_up_questions: The judges add 40 minutes of tasting. In hours, how long does the contest take altogether?

problem: The garden centre ordered 9 trays of seedlings for the holiday, with 24 seedlings on each tray. It sold 85 on Friday and 96 on Saturday. How many seedlings were left on Sunday morning?
follow_up_questions: On Sunday every leftover seedling sold for 2 dollars. How much did Sunday's sales make?
How many more seedlings were sold on Saturday than on Sunday?

problem: How many juice boxes remained after the camp weekend? The camp kitchen started with 9 cases of 24 juice boxes, and campers drank 85 on the first day and 96 on the second.
follow_up_questions: On the last day each remaining juice box was sold to parents for 2 dollars. How much money came in?
How many more juice boxes were drunk on the second day than were sold on the last day?

problem: Tomas sells hot chocolate at the ice rink, which has 25 benches around it. On Sunday he made 6 pots and poured 9 mugs from each pot. Every mug cost 2 dollars. How much money did he collect?
follow_up_questions: His milk, cocoa and cups cost 34 dollars. What was his profit?
He saves half of the profit. How much does he save?
From the money he did not save, he buys a new scarf for 12 dollars. How much does he have left to spend?

problem: How much did the cookie stall earn? Amelie baked 6 trays and got 9 cookies from each tray, then sold every cookie for 2 dollars. Her stall stood next to a fountain that is 60 years old.
follow_up_questions: Flour, butter and bags cost her 34 dollars. How much profit did she make?
Half of the profit goes into her piggy bank. How much is that?
Out of the rest, she spends 12 dollars on a cookie cutter set. How much remains for spending?

problem: To raise money for a class trip, the pupils baked bread for 6 hours on Saturday and made 7 loaves every hour. Each loaf sold for 5 dollars. How much did they make on Saturday?
follow_up_questions: On Sunday they sold 18 loaves at the same price. How much did they make over the weekend?

problem: How much did the dog walkers earn on Saturday? They worked for 6 hours, walked 7 dogs in each hour, and charged 5 dollars per dog.
follow_up_questions: On Sunday they walked 18 dogs at the same price. What did they earn over both days?

problem: Mr. Lindgren is making name badges for the science fair. He sticks 6 gold dots on each of 8 badges. His sheet has 60 dots. How many dots will be left when the badges are finished?
A florist has a box of 60 ribbons. How many ribbons remain after she ties 6 ribbons around each of 8 gift baskets?

The school orchestra is giving a concert in the gym. There are 8 rows of 10 chairs, and 12 chairs are kept for the teachers. The programmes were printed in blue ink. How many chairs are left for the audience?
follow_up_questions: All but 9 of those chairs were sold. How many tickets were sold?
Every ticket was 2 dollars. How much did the ticket sales bring in?

problem: How many places are free for visitors at the puppet show? The tent holds 8 benches with 10 places each, and 12 places are reserved for the puppeteers' friends. A red curtain hung across the stage.
follow_up_questions: Tickets were sold for every free place except 9. How many tickets were sold?
A ticket cost 2 dollars. What was the total money collected?

problem: A long bus trip has three parts. The first part takes 95 minutes, the second takes 12 minutes less than the first, and the last part takes 90 minutes. How many minutes does the trip last?
follow_up_questions: The bus stops for 15 minutes after each of the first 2 parts. How long is the trip with the stops?

problem: How long, in minutes, is the hiking day? Walking the first trail takes 95 minutes; the second trail is 12 minutes quicker than the first; the third trail takes 90 minutes.
follow_up_questions: There is a 15-minute rest after each of the first two trails. What is the total time with the rests?

problem: The school is putting new carpet tiles in the reading room, which holds 30 beanbags. The room is 9 tiles wide and 14 tiles long, but a built-in bookcase covers 12 tiles that do not need carpet. How many carpet tiles are needed?
follow_up_questions: Carpet tiles come in boxes of 6. How many boxes must be ordered?
A box costs 8 dollars. What will the boxes cost?
The parents' group pays for 9 of the boxes. How much does the school still have to pay?

problem: How many new paving stones does the courtyard need? It measures 9 stones by 14 stones, but a fountain built 40 years ago takes up the space of 12 stones.
follow_up_questions: The stones are delivered in stacks of 6. How many stacks must be ordered?
Each stack costs 8 dollars. What is the cost of the stones?
A builder donates 9 stacks. How much is left to pay?

problem: Amira earns money by walking dogs. She gets 6 dollars for a big dog and 3 dollars for a small dog. Today she walked 4 big dogs and 5 small dogs. How much did she earn?
follow_up_questions: She spent 12 dollars on a new leash. How much money does she have left?

problem: How much did Leo make washing windows on Saturday? He charges 6 dollars for a house window and 3 dollars for a car window, and he washed 4 house windows and 5 car windows.
follow_up_questions: He paid 12 dollars for a new sponge and bucket. What is left?

problem: The community centre held a card game afternoon. At 9 tables, 4 people were playing at each one, and 14 others were watching. The tea urn bubbled in the corner. How many people were at the centre altogether?
How many swimmers were at the pool? There were 9 lanes with 4 swimmers in each lane, plus 14 swimmers waiting on the side. The water was a little cold.

The toy shop is setting up 7 remote-control cars for a race. Each car takes 4 batteries, and the shop wants 6 spare batteries as well. The race track is 20 metres long. How many batteries does the shop need?
follow_up_questions: Batteries come in pairs. How many pairs are needed?

problem: How many light bulbs should the theatre buy? Each of its 7 stage lamps holds 4 bulbs, and the crew wants 6 spare bulbs. The play has 11 actors.
follow_up_questions: The bulbs come in packs of 2. How many packs is that?

problem: A baker brings 50 loaves to the market. She sells 8 in the first hour and twice as many in the second hour. How many loaves are left?
follow_up_questions: Then she sells 9 more to a cafe. How many loaves are left now?
Every loaf costs 3 dollars. How much money did she get for all the loaves she sold today?
She paid 40 dollars for her market stall. How much money does she have after paying for it?

problem: How many newspapers are still in the bundle? A paper seller started with 50 newspapers, sold 8 at the train station, and sold double that number at the bus stop.
follow_up_questions: After that he sells 9 more outside the bank. How many newspapers remain?
One newspaper costs 3 dollars. How much did he take in for all the newspapers he sold?
He pays 40 dollars for the day's papers. How much money does he keep?

problem: Two sisters sell cookies at the school fair to buy a new board game. Ana bakes 3 trays with 9 cookies each, and Sofia bakes 2 trays with 8 cookies each. How many cookies do they have to sell?
follow_up_questions: They sold every cookie for 4 dollars. How much did they make?
They split the money equally between the two of them. How much does each sister get?

problem: How many flowers can the friends sell at the market? Ravi brings 3 buckets holding 9 flowers each, and Meena brings 2 buckets holding 8 flowers each.
follow_up_questions: Each flower sells for 4 dollars. What do they earn?
They share the money equally between both of them. How much does each friend get?

problem: The chess club needs 95 dollars for new boards. At their bake sale they sold cakes for 5 dollars each, selling 12 in the morning and 9 in the afternoon. How much more than they needed did they raise?
By how many dollars did the art class go over its goal? The class wanted 95 dollars for paint, and it sold paintings at 5 dollars each: 12 on Friday and 9 on Saturday.
Mr. Santos is making 14 banners for sports day. Each banner uses 2 metres of ribbon, and the craft shop sells ribbon on rolls of 4 metres. How many rolls should he buy?
follow_up_questions: One roll costs 9 dollars. How much will the ribbon cost?

problem: How many sacks of flour must the bakery buy? It is baking 14 big cakes, each using 2 kilograms of flour, and flour comes in sacks of 4 kilograms.
follow_up_questions: Each sack costs 9 dollars. What is the cost of the flour?

problem: For sports day, the field had 18 benches that seat 5 people each, plus 26 stools. The first race began 10 minutes late because of rain. How many people could sit?
follow_up_questions: When the first race started, 9 seats were empty. How many people were sitting?

problem: How many guests can sit down at the garden party? There are 18 picnic tables with room for 5 people at each, and 26 extra garden chairs. The party started at 3 o'clock.
follow_up_questions: Only 9 places were empty once everyone arrived. How many guests were sitting?

problem: Aisha took her 3 friends to the bowling alley. A game cost 8 dollars per person, and Aisha paid for all of them, herself included, with 40 dollars. How much change did she get?
follow_up_questions: With the change she bought drinks at 2 dollars each. How many drinks could she buy?
Next time, 2 more friends will join. How much would one game for everyone cost then?

problem: How much change does Mr. Brooks get at the swimming pool? He brings his 3 children, a swim ticket costs 8 dollars for each person, and he pays for everyone, himself too, with 40 dollars.
follow_up_questions: He spends all the change on ice lollies at 2 dollars each. How many lollies does he buy?
Next week 2 of the children's friends come too. What would the tickets cost then?

problem: The park has 5 picnic areas with 4 tables in each, but 3 tables are being repaired. An ice cream van played music by the path. On Sunday each table that could be used was shared by 3 families. How many families used the tables?

How many children rode the rocking horses at the fair? The fair had 5 carousels with 4 rocking horses on each, but 3 horses were out of order. A clown was juggling by the entrance. Every horse that worked was ridden by 3 children.
A sports shop sells tennis balls in tubes of 4. It had 23 tubes and sold 9 tubes on Sunday. How many tennis balls are left in the shop?
follow_up_questions: A delivery brings 12 more tubes. How many tennis balls does the shop have now?

problem: How many yogurt cups are still in the fridge at the corner shop? Yogurts come in packs of 4, the shop had 23 packs, and 9 packs were bought this morning.
follow_up_questions: The supplier drops off 12 more packs. How many yogurt cups are in the fridge now?

problem: At the orchard, 5 friends each picked 6 big apples, and together they picked 15 small apples as well. How many apples did they pick?
follow_up_questions: On the way home they ate a third of them. How many apples were left?
They shared the remaining apples equally. How many apples did each friend get?

problem: How many paper cranes were folded? During the rainy afternoon, 5 classmates folded 6 large cranes each, and as a group they folded 15 tiny ones.
follow_up_questions: They gave a third of the cranes to the hospital. How many cranes were left?
The classmates shared out the remaining cranes equally. How many did each take home?

problem: The art club met after school, which ends at 3 o'clock. The leader found 9 boxes with 35 buttons in each. Every button picture uses 15 buttons. How many pictures can the club make?
follow_up_questions: There are 26 children in the club. How many more pictures are needed so each child gets one?
How many more buttons does the leader need for those extra pictures?
Buttons come in bags of 25. How many bags must she buy?

problem: How many sock puppets can the drama group make? Their cupboard holds 9 tubs with 35 sequins in each, and every puppet is decorated with 15 sequins. The cupboard had not been opened for 2 years.
follow_up_questions: The group has 26 members. How many more puppets are needed so every member has one?
How many more sequins does the group need to make those puppets?
Sequins are sold in packets of 25. How many packets must be bought?

problem: The swimming pool has one diving board, and divers take turns. This month there were 6 practice days; 9 divers came each day, and every diver got 4 minutes on the board. How many minutes was the diving board used?
follow_up_questions: Next month there will be only 4 practice days, with the same divers and the same minutes each. How many fewer minutes will the board be used?

problem: For how many minutes was the class microscope in use? The science club met on 6 afternoons, 9 pupils came each afternoon, and each pupil looked through the microscope for 4 minutes.
follow_up_questions: Next term the club meets on just 4 afternoons with the same pupils and minutes. How many fewer minutes will the microscope be used?

problem: Auntie Grace sells soup at the winter market. She brought 4 pots of tomato soup, and each pot fills 20 bowls. By evening she had sold 65 bowls. Snow fell softly on the stalls. How many bowls of soup were left?
follow_up_questions: She pours the rest into jars that hold 3 bowls each. How many jars does she fill?
She sells each jar for 4 dollars. How much does she get for them?

problem: How many slices of pizza did Mr. Kim have left at the school disco? He ordered 4 giant pizzas cut into 20 slices each, and 65 slices were eaten. The disco lights flashed pink and green.
follow_up_questions: He packs the leftover slices into boxes of 3. How many boxes does he fill?
Each box is sold to parents for 4 dollars. How much money comes in?

problem: A pancake recipe uses 3 eggs for every 4 pancakes. Jamal wants to make 36 pancakes for the class breakfast. How many eggs does he need?
follow_up_questions: Eggs are sold in trays of 9. How many trays must he buy?

problem: How many cups of flour will the baker use? Her bread recipe needs 3 cups of flour for every 4 rolls, and she is baking 36 rolls.
follow_up_questions: Flour comes in bags that hold 9 cups. How many bags will she need?

problem: The football team held a bake sale using 3 long tables. They sold 28 cakes at 6 dollars each and 9 pies at 8 dollars each. How much money did the bake sale raise?
follow_up_questions: Flour and sugar cost them 35 dollars. How much did the team keep?
A coach then donated 45 dollars. How much does the team have now?
New footballs cost 25 dollars each. How many can the team buy with that money?

problem: How much money did the plant sale make? The garden club sold 28 pots of herbs for 6 dollars each and 9 small trees for 8 dollars each, from a stall with 2 big umbrellas.
follow_up_questions: Soil and pots had cost 35 dollars. How much money did the club keep?
A neighbour then gave the club 45 dollars. How much money does the club have now?
Garden benches cost 25 dollars each. How many benches can the club buy?

problem: Yuki read for 20 minutes each evening for 6 evenings before the reading contest. On the last evening she read for 35 minutes. How many minutes did she read altogether?
follow_up_questions: Her brother read 40 minutes less than Yuki. How long did he read?

problem: How many minutes did Coach Bello's team train? They trained for 20 minutes on each of 6 days, then had one long 35-minute session before the match.
follow_up_questions: The second team trained 40 fewer minutes. How many minutes did the second team train?

problem: At the zoo, a group ticket for four people costs 30 dollars, and one single ticket costs 9 dollars. The Novak family bought 2 group tickets and 3 single tickets. The penguins were the best part of the day. How much did they spend?

What did the Haddad family pay at the water park? They bought 3 single passes at 9 dollars each and 2 family passes at 30 dollars each. A family pass lets in four people. The wave pool was very crowded.
Students are making paper chains for the school hall. Each chain needs 10 links, and they are making 7 chains. They have already made 26 links. How many links still need to be made?
follow_up_questions: Each link takes 3 minutes. How long will the rest of the links take?
They work for 45 minutes before the bell. How many minutes of work are left after the bell?

problem: How many tiles are still unglued on the mosaic? The mosaic has 7 rows of 10 tiles, and the art club has glued 26 tiles so far.
follow_up_questions: Gluing one tile takes 3 minutes. How many minutes will the remaining tiles take?
The club glues for 45 minutes on Tuesday. How many minutes of gluing are left after that?

problem: The library lends umbrellas on rainy days. On Monday 12 umbrellas were borrowed, on Tuesday 8, and on Wednesday 3 times as many as on Tuesday. The library has 40 shelves. How many umbrellas were borrowed over the three days?
follow_up_questions: Each umbrella is dried with 2 towels when it comes back. How many towels were used?

problem: How many life jackets did the boat club lend out over the three days? It lent 12 on Friday and 8 on Saturday, and on Sunday it lent 3 times the Saturday number. The lake is 70 metres wide.
follow_up_questions: Every jacket is rinsed with 2 buckets of water afterwards. How many buckets of water were used?

problem: On a snowy day, Uncle Ravi made dumplings with his nieces. They made 4 plates of 12 dumplings and ate 6 straight away. How many dumplings were left?
follow_up_questions: They put the rest into boxes of 3 for friends. How many boxes did they fill?
Only 9 friends came to pick up a box. How many boxes were left?

problem: How many cookies remained after the baking session? The scouts baked 4 sheets of 12 cookies, and the leader ate 6 to check they were good.
follow_up_questions: The rest were wrapped in packets of 3 to sell. How many packets were there?
Only 9 packets were sold. How many packets were not sold?

problem: For a whole week, the bird club counted birds at the feeder. On every sunny day they counted 38 birds, but 2 of the days were stormy and no birds came. How many birds did they count during the week?
What was the cafe's muffin total for the week? On each day it was open it baked 38 muffins, but it was closed on 2 days of that week.
A toy train moves 15 centimetres every second. In a test, it went forward for 12 seconds and then backward for 9 seconds. How far from where it started did it stop?
follow_up_questions: In the next test it went forward for 20 seconds without stopping. How much farther from the start did it get this time?

problem: How far from the dock is the little ferry? It travels 15 metres every minute; it sailed out for 12 minutes, then turned and came back for 9 minutes.
follow_up_questions: On its next trip it sails straight out for 20 minutes. How much farther from the dock is it this time?

problem: It was 30 degrees on the busiest day of the fair, and Paolo's smoothie stand had a long line. He made 26 large smoothies using 3 bananas each and sold 42 single bananas too. How many bananas did he go through?
follow_up_questions: Bananas come in boxes of 40. How many boxes did he empty?

problem: How many pancakes did the breakfast club serve? The cook made 26 stacks of 3 pancakes and sold 42 single pancakes as well, on a morning when the club had 15 tables.
follow_up_questions: One bag of mix makes 40 pancakes. How many bags did the cook use?

problem: At the school fair, the face-painting table needs 12 minutes for each child. It stays open for 2 hours without a break and charges 8 dollars a face. Lots of parents also bought lemonade nearby. How much money does the table make?
How much does the bike repair stand earn? The mechanic spends 12 minutes fixing each bike, works for 2 hours straight, and charges 8 dollars for every bike. A band played music across the square.
The art club paid 90 dollars to rent a gallery for its show. It sold 96 tickets on Saturday and 78 on Sunday, at 4 dollars each. How much money was left after paying the rent?
follow_up_questions: The club splits that money equally between two projects, a mural and a sculpture. How much does each project get?

problem: How much profit did the choir make from its spring show? Tickets cost 4 dollars, 96 were sold for the afternoon show and 78 for the evening show, and the stage hire cost 90 dollars.
follow_up_questions: The profit is shared equally by the choir's two groups. How much does each group get?

problem: The big sports hall, built 20 years ago, has 4 courts with 85 seats around each court. On Friday evening every court was full except for 13 empty seats at each one. How many people were watching?
follow_up_questions: Each ticket was 3 dollars. How much money was taken on Friday?
On Saturday, 50 fewer people came. How many came on Saturday?
How many people came on the two evenings together?

problem: How many guests were at the hotel's dinner? The hotel has 4 dining rooms with 85 places each, and on that evening 13 places in every room were empty. The hotel has 9 floors.
follow_up_questions: Each guest paid 3 dollars for dessert. How much did dessert bring in?
At breakfast the next day, there were 50 fewer guests. How many came to breakfast?
Add the dinner and breakfast guests together. What is the total?

problem: A farmer is putting a fence around a rectangular vegetable patch that is 8 metres long and 6 metres wide. He will leave a 2-metre opening for the wheelbarrow. How many metres of fence does he need?
follow_up_questions: The fence is sold in rolls that are 2 metres long. How many rolls does he need?

problem: How many metres of rope are needed to go around the paddling pool area? The area is a rectangle, 6 metres wide and 8 metres long, and a gap of 2 metres is left for the entrance.
follow_up_questions: The rope comes in pieces 2 metres long. How many pieces are needed?

problem: Twelve children joined the swimming lesson. The teacher put them into groups of 3 and gave each group 2 floats. How many floats did the teacher hand out?
How many paintbrushes did the art teacher put out? She had 12 pupils working in groups of 3, with 2 brushes for every group.

The class collected rainwater for the school garden. On Monday they caught 12 litres and on Tuesday three times as much. They pour the water into buckets that hold 6 litres. How many buckets can they fill?
follow_up_questions: They use 5 buckets on the beans. How many litres of water are left?

problem: How many jugs can the camp cooks fill? The spring gave 12 litres of water in the morning and three times that amount in the afternoon, and every jug holds 6 litres.
follow_up_questions: The cooks used 5 jugs for soup. How many litres of water remain?

problem: For the school's art week, every child is making paper flowers. There are 9 tables with 7 children at each, and every child makes 2 flowers. The art room has 5 windows. How many flowers are made?
follow_up_questions: The flowers are stuck onto boards that hold 9 flowers each. How many boards are needed?
Each board needs 4 hooks to hang it. How many hooks are needed?
A packet has 60 hooks. How many hooks will be left?

problem: How many cards will the class write for the care home? There are 9 groups of 7 pupils, and every pupil writes 2 cards. The care home is 3 streets away.
follow_up_questions: The cards are put into envelopes of 9 cards each. How many envelopes are needed?
Every envelope gets 4 stickers on the front. How many stickers are needed?
A roll has 60 stickers. How many stickers will be left on the roll?

problem: Lina works at the swimming pool snack bar. A sandwich costs 4 dollars. A dad buys 5 sandwiches and pays with a 50-dollar note. How much change does he get?
follow_up_questions: The next customer buys 3 sandwiches and pays with a 20-dollar note. How much change does she get?

problem: What change comes back from a 50-dollar note when a teacher buys 5 notebooks at 4 dollars each?
follow_up_questions: Then a pupil buys 3 notebooks with a 20-dollar note. How much change does the pupil get?

problem: At the swimming gala, the water stand had 6 crates with 32 bottles in each. The blue team won the last relay. When the gala ended, 50 bottles were left. How many bottles had been handed out?
How many hot dogs were sold at the baseball game? The stall started with 6 boxes of 32 hot dogs, and 50 hot dogs were left at the end. The home team hit a home run in the last inning.
Sara and her mum walked dogs in their neighbourhood to save for a holiday. They walked 13 dogs on Saturday and twice as many on Sunday. How many dogs did they walk?
follow_up_questions: Each owner paid 7 dollars. How much did they earn?
Sara kept a third of the money. How much did she keep?

problem: How many lawns did Mateo and his grandpa mow? On the first weekend they mowed 13 lawns, and on the second weekend double that number.
follow_up_questions: They were paid 7 dollars a lawn. What did they earn?
Mateo was given a third of the money. How much was that?

problem: Forty invitation cards are needed for the spring fair, and every card uses 2 sheets of coloured paper. Coloured paper is sold 10 sheets to a pack. The fair is 6 days away. How many packs does the class need?
follow_up_questions: One pack costs 3 dollars. How much will the paper cost?

problem: How many bundles of sticks must the scouts buy? They are building 40 bird feeders that use 2 sticks each, sticks come in bundles of 10, and the camp is 15 kilometres from town.
follow_up_questions: Each bundle costs 3 dollars. What do the sticks cost?

problem: The football team travels to a match in two vans. Each van has 12 seats, and 5 seats are empty. How many people are in the vans?
follow_up_questions: Each person pays 3 dollars toward the trip. How much money is collected?
The petrol costs 40 dollars. How much money is left?
On the way back, 4 more players climb in. How many seats are empty now?

problem: How many campers are rowing across the lake? Two boats are being used, each with room for 12, and 5 places are not taken.
follow_up_questions: Every camper pays 3 dollars for the boat hire. How much is paid?
Hiring the boats costs 40 dollars. How much is left over?
For the trip back, 4 more campers get in. How many places are empty now?

problem: Omar is buying lunch for his friends at the zoo cafe. He buys 4 sandwiches at 7 dollars each and 3 juices at 4 dollars each. How much does he spend?
follow_up_questions: He pays with a 50-dollar note. How much change does he get?
The next week he buys the same lunch again. How much did he spend on lunch over the two weeks?

problem: What is the total cost at the art shop? Mrs. Tanaka picks up 4 paint sets at 7 dollars each and 3 sketch pads at 4 dollars each.
follow_up_questions: If she hands over a 50-dollar note, what change does she get?
A month later she buys exactly the same things again. How much has she spent on both trips together?

problem: Ms. Park is moving 48 boxes of books to the new library. Her van holds 9 boxes, and she has already made 3 trips. Now her daughter is coming to help, so the van only has room for 7 boxes a trip. How many more trips must she make?

How many more trips will the farmer need? He has to carry 48 hay bales to the barn; his trailer took 9 bales on each of his first 3 trips, but a wheel is wobbling, so from now on he loads only 7 bales a trip.
Hugo wants to go to the climbing wall 10 times this month. One visit costs 4 dollars, but a card for ten visits costs 30 dollars. How much does he save with the card?
follow_up_questions: His friend Pablo climbs 13 times and pays for each visit. How much more does Pablo spend than Hugo does with his card?

problem: How much cheaper is the swim card for Zara? She plans to swim 10 times, a single swim costs 4 dollars, and a card good for ten swims costs 30 dollars.
follow_up_questions: Her cousin swims 13 times, paying for every swim. How much more does her cousin pay than Zara pays for her card?

problem: The ice rink was open all day during the holiday. Skating costs 9 dollars for children and 14 dollars for adults, and a group of 6 children and 3 adults went skating. The rink is 60 metres long. How much did the group pay?
follow_up_questions: They also rented 6 pairs of skates at 5 dollars each. How much did they spend in total?

problem: What did the museum visit cost the group? Entry is 9 dollars per child and 14 dollars per adult; 6 children and 3 adults went in. The museum has 40 rooms.
follow_up_questions: They also bought 6 audio guides at 5 dollars each. What did they spend altogether?

problem: Four friends are building a big castle out of 96 blocks. They split the blocks equally, and Jonas has already used 17 of his. The castle will be shown at the school fair. How many of Jonas's blocks are still unused?

How many stickers does Mira still need to put on? The 96 stickers for the class poster were shared equally among 4 classmates, Mira included, and she has stuck on 17 of hers so far. The poster is about rainforest animals.
The science fair gave out 99 light bulbs in the morning. Each of the 7 schools brought 3 models, and every model uses 4 bulbs. How many of the bulbs were not used?
follow_up_questions: The unused bulbs were packed into boxes of 5. How many boxes were filled?

problem: How many sandwiches were left over at sports day? The kitchen made 99 sandwiches, and each of the 7 teams had 3 tables with 4 sandwiches on every table.
follow_up_questions: The leftovers were put into bags of 5 for the helpers. How many bags were filled?

problem: The bakery makes 8 kinds of bread, and this morning it baked 9 loaves of each kind. On the way to the shop, 5 loaves fell off the tray and were ruined. How many loaves reached the shop?
follow_up_questions: By noon, 18 loaves had been sold. How many were still on the shelves?
In the afternoon, twice as many loaves were sold as in the morning. How many loaves were left at closing time?

problem: How many jars of honey made it to the market stall? The beekeeper filled 9 jars of each of her 8 honey types, but 5 jars broke on the bumpy road.
follow_up_questions: By lunch she had sold 18 jars. How many jars were still on the stall?
After lunch she sold double the number she sold before lunch. How many jars were left when the market closed?

problem: Every Sunday in May, Leila sold cookies at the farmers' market, which has 30 stalls. There were 4 Sundays, and she sold 23 cookies each time at 2 dollars a cookie. How much money did she make?
follow_up_questions: She spent 28 dollars on flour and butter. How much was left?
She gave half of what was left to her brother for helping. How much did her brother get?
Leila wants a scooter that costs 95 dollars. How much more does she need after giving her brother his share?

problem: How much did Kwame earn from washing bikes? He set up his stand on 4 Saturdays, washed 23 bikes each Saturday, and charged 2 dollars a bike. His street has 12 houses.
follow_up_questions: Soap and sponges cost him 28 dollars. How much money was left?
He gave half of that to his sister, who helped him. How much did his sister get?
Kwame is saving for a 95-dollar football kit. After giving his sister her share, how much more does he need?

problem: The netball team sold breakfast on 3 mornings of the school holiday. Each morning 15 people came, and every person paid 6 dollars for food plus 2 dollars for a drink. How much money did the team collect?
follow_up_questions: The food and drinks cost 45 dollars. How much did the team raise after paying for them?

problem: What did the pet-wash day raise for the animal shelter? It ran for 3 days with 15 dogs washed each day, and every owner paid 6 dollars for the bath and 2 dollars for a brush-out.
follow_up_questions: Shampoo and towels cost 45 dollars. How much money was raised after paying for them?

problem: The class is putting on a puppet show with 5 acts. The children need 4 puppets for each act, but they have only made 12 so far. How many puppets are still missing?
How many costumes are still to be sewn? The dance show has 5 dances with 4 costumes in each dance, and 12 costumes are finished.

The school talent show has 3 parts, and each part lasts 20 minutes. There are two breaks between the parts, 10 minutes each. The host wore a sparkly green hat. How long does the show last from beginning to end?
follow_up_questions: The show is put on 3 times during the week. How many minutes of acts, not counting breaks, are there altogether?
How many hours of acts is that?

problem: How many minutes does the swimming gala last from start to finish? It is split into 3 rounds of 20 minutes each, with two 10-minute breaks between the rounds. The pool was decorated with flags.
follow_up_questions: The gala is held on 3 Saturdays. How many minutes of racing, without the breaks, is that in all?
Change that racing time into hours. How many hours is it?

problem: The juice factory received 9 crates of oranges with 12 nets in each crate. Each net makes 8 bottles of juice. What is the most bottles the factory can make?
follow_up_questions: For a whole week, the factory sold 95 bottles every day. How many bottles can it still make after that week?

problem: What is the greatest number of candles the craft shop can make? It ordered 9 cartons of wax with 12 blocks in each carton, and each block makes 8 candles.
follow_up_questions: Over one week it sold 95 candles a day. How many candles can it still make once that week is over?

problem: The library wants 8 new reading chairs. Each chair costs 45 dollars. Friends of the library raised 95 dollars at a book sale and 85 dollars at a quiz night. The library has 20 computers. How much more money is needed?
follow_up_questions: A shop gives 2 of the chairs for free. How much is still needed now?
They plan 3 more events that each raise the same amount. How much must each event raise?
The first event raised 12 dollars more than planned. How much did it raise?

problem: How much more money does the football club need for 8 new goals that cost 45 dollars each? So far it has raised 95 dollars from a car wash and 85 dollars from a raffle. The club has 60 players.
follow_up_questions: A local business pays for 2 of the goals. How much does the club still need?
The club plans 3 more fundraisers that each bring in the same amount. How much does each have to raise?
The first fundraiser brought in 12 dollars more than planned. How much was that?

problem: Because of the snow, the swimming gala was held at the indoor pool. The 84 swimmers were put into relay teams of 6, and each team needed 2 stopwatches. The pool water was very warm. Find how many stopwatches the coach had to find.
How many maps did the leader hand out? On the camp's treasure hunt day, the 84 campers were split into teams of 6, and every team got 2 maps. The forest smelled of pine trees.
The art club painted 6 pictures of each of the 8 farm animals. They have hung 21 pictures in the hall. How many pictures have not been hung yet?
follow_up_questions: The rest go to 3 classrooms, the same number in each. How many pictures does each classroom get?
Later the club paints 14 pictures of horses. How many pictures has the club painted now?

problem: How many fact cards still need a home? The nature club made 8 sets of 6 fact cards about rivers and has pinned 21 of them on the corridor wall.
follow_up_questions: The others are shared equally between 3 classrooms. How many cards does each classroom get?
Then the club writes 14 fact cards about lakes. How many fact cards has the club made in all?

problem: For the birdhouse workshop, the scouts bought 3 bags of 12 nails. Each birdhouse needs 4 nails. The workshop lasts 2 hours. How many birdhouses can the scouts build?
follow_up_questions: They build 6 birdhouses on Saturday. How many nails are left?

problem: How many shelves can Mr. Diaz put up? He bought 3 packs of 12 screws, and one shelf takes 4 screws. His toolbox is 40 years old.
follow_up_questions: He puts up 6 shelves this weekend. How many screws does he have left?

problem: For the school fun day, Malik made 3 plates of 8 sandwiches, and his mum made 10 more. How many sandwiches did they bring?
follow_up_questions: They sold all but 4 of them for 2 dollars each. How much money did they make?
They shared the leftover sandwiches equally between 2 helpers. How many did each helper get?
Malik gave a quarter of the money to the school garden. How much did the garden get?

problem: How many pies did Hana and her grandpa bake for the fete? Hana baked 3 trays of 8 small pies, and her grandpa baked 10 more.
follow_up_questions: All but 4 pies were sold at 2 dollars each. How much money did the pies bring in?
The unsold pies were shared equally between 2 neighbours. How many pies did each neighbour get?
A quarter of the money went to the village hall. How much did the hall get?

problem: On the farm visit, the farmer showed the class the big barn. It holds 14 cows and 6 times as many chickens. How many animals are in the barn?
follow_up_questions: At feeding time the farmer gives every animal 3 scoops of feed. How many scoops does he need?
He brought 4 sacks with 80 scoops in each. How many scoops are left after feeding?

problem: How many birds live in the aviary? The zoo keeper says there are 14 parrots and 6 times as many finches.
follow_up_questions: Every bird is given 3 berries as a treat. How many berries are needed?
The keeper carried in 4 tubs of 80 berries. How many berries remain after the treat?

problem: The art gallery has 8 halls with 9 paintings in each hall. On the school tour, the guide spends 3 minutes at every painting. How long does the whole tour take?
follow_up_questions: Today 2 of the halls are closed. How many minutes shorter is the tour?

problem: How many minutes does the keeper's talk tour at the zoo last? The zoo has 8 zones with 9 animal enclosures in each, and the keeper talks for 3 minutes at every enclosure.
follow_up_questions: Today 2 of the zones are shut for cleaning. By how many minutes is the tour shorter?

problem: The tennis club needs balls for Sunday's tournament. There will be 9 courts in use, every court needs 16 balls, and the coach wants 8 spare balls in a bucket. What is the total number of balls needed?
follow_up_questions: The club already has 95 balls. How many more must it buy?

problem: The hotel staff are setting up 9 meeting rooms, each needing 16 chairs, plus 8 extra chairs kept by the door. How many chairs must they bring?
follow_up_questions: There are 95 chairs in the store room. How many more chairs must they borrow?

problem: A crate held 60 apples. The summer camp has 4 cabins of 7 campers, and each camper took 2 apples for the hike, which was 5 kilometres long. How many apples were left in the crate?
follow_up_questions: At lunch, the cook opens a new crate of 60 apples and adds them to the leftovers. How many apples are there now?
On the way home, every camper eats 2 more apples. How many apples are left after that?

problem: Each of the singers took 2 biscuits from the tin, which had 60 at the start. The choir stands in 4 rows of 7 singers, and practice lasted 90 minutes. How many biscuits did the tin still hold?
follow_up_questions: During the break, a parent tips a new packet of 60 biscuits into the tin. How many biscuits are in it now?
Before going home, each singer takes 2 more biscuits. How many biscuits are left?

problem: Sven brought 3 boxes of 8 books to the school book swap. His sister brought 15 books in a backpack. How many books did they bring together?
How many eggs did the farm children collect? Lucia filled 3 baskets with 8 eggs in each, and her cousin found 15 more eggs in the straw.
What does Nadia spend at the bakery, in cents? She buys 6 buns at 45 cents each and one pie for 85 cents.
follow_up_questions: She hands over 4 one-dollar coins. What is her change in cents?
She spends all the change on sweets that cost 15 cents each. How many sweets does she buy?
Each sweet wrapper has 2 jokes printed on it. How many jokes can she read?

problem: How many cents does Mr. Ito pay at the stationery shop? He picks out 6 pencils at 45 cents each and a ruler at 85 cents.
follow_up_questions: He pays using 4 one-dollar coins. How much change, in cents, does he receive?
With that change he buys erasers at 15 cents each. How many erasers can he buy?
He gives each eraser to a pupil along with 2 stickers. How many stickers does he need?

problem: The school nurse started the term with 40 ice packs in the freezer. She handed out 12 ice packs in the first week and 15 in the second. How many were left?
follow_up_questions: A delivery of 3 boxes with 10 ice packs in each arrives. How many ice packs are in the freezer now?
Over the next week she hands out 19. How many are left at the end?

problem: How many tickets were left at the zoo gate at closing time? The booth opened with 40 tickets, and 12 were sold before lunch and 15 after lunch.
follow_up_questions: The next day, 3 rolls of 10 tickets are added. How many tickets are there?
That day 19 tickets are sold. How many tickets remain?

problem: The new swimming pool will be lined with 15 rows of 48 tiles, and the workers have already finished 9 rows. Find how many tiles they still have to lay.
A stadium stand has 48 seats in each of its 15 rows. If 9 rows of seats have already been painted, how many seats are still waiting for paint?
Grandpa Joe is filling 6 small candle holders with two candles each and 4 large holders with three candles each. His workshop smelled of fresh pine. How many candles does he need?
follow_up_questions: He had a box of 30 candles. How many are left after filling all the holders?
Then a neighbour asks for one more large holder. How many candles are left once he fills it?

problem: A flower arranger puts three roses in each of 4 tall vases and two roses in each of 6 short vases. Soft music played in the shop. How many roses does she use?
follow_up_questions: She had a bucket of 30 roses. How many roses are left in the bucket?
A customer then orders one more tall vase. How many roses are left after she fills it?

problem: Hiro bought 8 bags of 12 oranges and put 7 oranges in each of 13 gift baskets. How many oranges did he have left over?
follow_up_questions: He sells each leftover orange for 3 dollars. How much does he earn if they all sell?

problem: For the class party, Ms. Abara bought 8 packs of 12 pencils. She tied 7 pencils together into each of 13 gift bundles. Work out how many pencils were not used.
follow_up_questions: She sells the unused pencils to other teachers for 3 dollars each. How much money does she get?

problem: At the zoo, a camel ride costs 4 dollars a person. In the Silva family, 5 of them rode a camel, and they bought 3 animal books at 9 dollars each. How much did they spend?
follow_up_questions: They paid with a 50-dollar note. What change did they get?
Grandpa adds 7 dollars to the change, and they spend all of it on ice lollies at 2 dollars each. How many lollies do they buy?
Each lolly comes with 3 stickers. How many stickers do they get?

problem: What did the Moreau family pay at the bowling alley? Shoe hire there costs 4 dollars a person, 5 of them hired shoes, and they also bought 3 milkshakes at 9 dollars each.
follow_up_questions: They handed over a 50-dollar note. How much change came back?
Aunt Claire puts 7 dollars with the change, and they spend it all on arcade tokens costing 2 dollars each. How many tokens do they get?
Each token gives 3 goes on the claw machine. How many goes is that?

problem: The Moreno twins spent Saturday at the water park. Each of the two rode the big slide 3 times and the wave ride 4 times, and every ride cost 5 tokens. They also watched a show with 6 dolphins. How many tokens did they use?
follow_up_questions: They had bought 90 tokens at the entrance. How many tokens are left?
At the gift shop, every prize costs 4 tokens. How many prizes can they get with the leftover tokens?

problem: How many tickets did the two brothers spend at the funfair? Both of them went on the dodgems 3 times and the big wheel 4 times. Each go cost 5 tickets. They stayed until 9 o'clock.
follow_up_questions: They started with 90 tickets. How many tickets do they still have?
At the prize stall, every prize costs 4 tickets. How many prizes can they win with what is left?

problem: At the start of the art class there were 5 tables with two pupils at each. Then 7 more pupils arrived and 3 went home early. How many pupils are in the art class now?
follow_up_questions: The teacher pairs everyone up for a project, two pupils per project. How many projects are there?

problem: How many people are on the dance floor now? At first there were 5 couples, with two dancers in each couple; later 7 more dancers joined and 3 sat down.
follow_up_questions: Every dance needs two partners. How many pairs can dance at once if everyone dances?

problem: A baker bought candles for 6 birthday cakes, 12 candles per cake, plus 10 spare ones. How many candles did she buy?
How many seeds did Mrs. Okoye's class plant? The children planted 12 seeds in each of 6 pots, and then pressed 10 more seeds into the window box.
The recycling centre pays 5 cents for every can. Mrs. Bauer's 24 pupils each brought 3 cans. How many cents did the class earn? The cans were washed before they were handed in.
follow_up_questions: The class adds 40 cents from its spare-change box. How many cents does it have now?
It spends all of it on pencils at 50 cents each. How many pencils can it buy?

problem: How many cents did the cub pack raise from old newspapers? Each of its 24 cubs brought 3 bundles, and every bundle earned 5 cents. A strong wind blew some papers across the yard.
follow_up_questions: The leader adds 40 cents of her own. How many cents are there now?
The cubs buy packets of seeds at 50 cents each. How many packets can they get?

problem: The bakery opened with 9 baskets of 10 bagels and had 18 left at closing. How many bagels were sold?
follow_up_questions: Each customer bought 4 bagels. How many customers bought bagels?

problem: How many pencils did the teacher hand out on the first day of school? She started with 9 boxes of 10 pencils, and 18 pencils were still in the cupboard at home time.
follow_up_questions: Every pupil received 4 pencils. How many pupils got pencils?

problem: A bakery baked 8 trays of 45 cookies, and its 6 delivery drivers shared them equally to take around town. The drivers left at 9 o'clock. How many cookies did each driver take?
follow_up_questions: One driver delivers 38 of her cookies before lunch. How many does she still have?
She delivers the rest to 2 cafes, the same number at each. How many cookies go to each cafe?
The last cafe has 15 tables and puts one cookie on each table. How many tables get no cookie?

problem: What number of flyers did each volunteer get? The 6 volunteers shared 8 bundles of 45 flyers equally before setting off at 10 o'clock.
follow_up_questions: One volunteer hands out 38 of hers in the morning. How many does she have left to hand out?
She splits the rest equally between 2 streets. How many flyers go on each street?
The second street has 15 houses, and each house gets at most one flyer. How many houses get none?

problem: How long will Arjun wait at the barber's, in minutes? Each haircut takes 15 minutes, there are 7 people in front of him, and the barber has a 20-minute lunch before starting on them.
follow_up_questions: Arjun's own haircut also takes 15 minutes. How many minutes pass from when he arrives until he leaves?
Parking costs 2 dollars for every 20 minutes. What does his dad pay for parking?

problem: The vet sees one pet every 15 minutes. Before seeing the 7 pets ahead of Lily's cat, she takes a 20-minute break. For how many minutes must Lily wait?
follow_up_questions: The cat's own check-up lasts 15 minutes too. How long is Lily at the vet in total?
The car park charges 2 dollars for each 20 minutes. How much does Lily's mum pay?

problem: The hospital has 3 night teams with 9 nurses on each. If 5 of the nurses are on holiday, how many nurses are working?
follow_up_questions: Each working nurse gets 2 new uniforms. How many uniforms is that?

problem: How many players can play in the tournament? The club has 3 teams of 9 players, but 5 players are injured.
follow_up_questions: Every player who can play gets 2 new shirts. How many shirts are needed?

problem: A lorry carries 4 crates of apples that weigh 85 kilograms each, and a 60-kilogram box of pears. What is the total weight of the load, in kilograms?
How many kilograms does the lift carry? Inside are a 60-kilogram trolley and 4 sacks of flour weighing 85 kilograms each.
The music shop had a good Saturday. It sold 7 recorders for 24 dollars each and fixed one guitar for 15 dollars. How much money came in?
follow_up_questions: On Sunday the shop took 49 dollars less than on Saturday. How much did it take on Sunday?

problem: How much did Farah's craft stall make? She sold 7 knitted hats at 24 dollars each and one scarf for 15 dollars.
follow_up_questions: The next day the stall made 49 dollars less. How much did it make that day?

problem: Nia stacked 8 boxes on the trolley, and her dad stacked twice as many. When they went over a bump, 5 boxes fell off. How many boxes are still on the trolley?
How many apples are still in the basket? Tom picked 8 apples, his sister picked twice as many, and they put them all in one basket, but 5 rolled out on the way home.
At the village pie contest, 13 bakers each brought 4 pies, but 6 pies were turned away because they were burnt. Bunting hung all around the hall. How many pies were judged?
follow_up_questions: The judges spent 2 minutes tasting each pie that was judged. How long did the tasting take?

problem: How many paintings were hung in the art show? There were 13 artists who each sent 4 paintings, and 6 paintings arrived with broken frames and were not hung. The gallery walls were painted white.
follow_up_questions: Visitors spent 2 minutes looking at each painting on the wall. How many minutes would it take to see them all?

problem: The badminton club holds a league for 4 weeks. It meets on 3 nights each week, and 6 matches are played each night. How many matches are in the league?
follow_up_questions: Every match result goes on a score card, and the cards come in packs of 8. How many packs are used?
A pack costs 3 dollars. How much do the packs cost in total?
The coach pays with 2 twenty-dollar notes. How much change does he get?

problem: How many swimming races are in the summer gala? It lasts 4 weeks, with races on 3 afternoons every week and 6 races each afternoon.
follow_up_questions: Each race gets a results sheet, and sheets come in books of 8. How many books are used?
One book costs 3 dollars. What is the cost of all the books?
The club secretary pays with 2 twenty-dollar notes. What is the change?

problem: Ten dancers each won 3 medals this season, and the coach handed out 4 extra medals at the party. How many medals were given out?
follow_up_questions: Each medal cost the club 2 dollars. What did the medals cost?
The club raised 90 dollars at a car wash to pay for them. How much money is left after paying for the medals?

problem: How many ribbons were handed out at the pony club? Each of the 10 riders won 3 ribbons, and the judge gave 4 more ribbons for good grooming.
follow_up_questions: Each ribbon cost the club 2 dollars. How much did the ribbons cost?
A cake sale raised 90 dollars to pay for them. How much money is left over?

problem: Kemal is wrapping presents for his cousins. He wraps 9 big presents with 2 bows each and 4 small presents with one bow each. His cat kept playing with the paper. How many bows does he need?
follow_up_questions: Each bow costs 2 dollars. How much does Kemal spend on bows?
He pays with a 50-dollar note. What change does he get?

problem: How many name tags does the camp leader need? Each of the 9 tents holds 2 campers who need a tag, and each of the 4 helpers needs one tag. The tags were printed in bright orange.
follow_up_questions: Each tag costs 2 dollars. How much does the leader spend on tags?
She pays with a 50-dollar note. How much change does she get?

problem: Every day a zoo keeper gives each of the 14 monkeys 3 bananas. How many bananas is that over the 6 days the zoo is open each week?
follow_up_questions: The bananas come in boxes of 42. How many boxes are emptied that week?

problem: How many worksheets does Mr. Owusu print for summer camp? Each day he gives 3 worksheets to each of his 14 campers, and the camp lasts 6 days.
follow_up_questions: Paper comes in packs of 42 sheets, one sheet per worksheet. How many packs does he use up?

problem: Every Saturday the bus company cleans its buses. Each of the 3 buses takes 35 minutes to clean, and the double-decker needs an extra 20 minutes on top. What is the total cleaning time, in minutes?
follow_up_questions: This month there are 4 cleaning Saturdays. How many minutes of cleaning is that?
Two cleaners share all of this work equally. How many minutes does each spend?
One cleaner has already worked 90 minutes. How many minutes does that cleaner still have to work?

problem: How many minutes does the groomer spend on the ponies each Friday? Each of the 3 ponies takes 35 minutes to brush, and the show pony needs another 20 minutes.
follow_up_questions: There are 4 Fridays this month. How many minutes of grooming is that?
Two stable hands share the grooming equally. How many minutes does each one spend?
One of them has already groomed for 90 minutes. How much longer does that stable hand have to go?

problem: The decorators bought 9 rolls of 20 stickers for the nursery wall. They used 13 rows of 12 stickers, and the room has 3 doors. How many stickers are left?
follow_up_questions: The leftovers go on a cupboard that needs 4 rows of 5 stickers. How many stickers remain after that?
Each remaining sticker is cut into 2 halves for a border. How many pieces is that?

problem: How many stamps are left after the poster is made? The club bought 9 sheets of 20 stamps, the poster used 13 rows of 12 stamps, and the poster took 6 days to finish.
follow_up_questions: The rest go on a card that needs 4 rows of 5 stamps. How many stamps are left then?
Each stamp that is left gets cut into 2 small pieces. How many pieces are there?

problem: A caterer is making 12 trays of sandwiches for a party, and each tray costs 35 dollars. The birthday cake costs another 90 dollars. How much is the whole order?
How much does the school pay for the trip? A 90-dollar guide fee is added to the cost of 12 coach seats at 35 dollars each.
A garden centre had 8 rows of 15 rose bushes. Customers bought 67 of them over the weekend. A cat slept in the sunny greenhouse. How many rose bushes are still for sale?
follow_up_questions: The owner plants 13 of them in her own garden and sells the rest at 6 dollars each. How much money does that bring in?
She spends 75 dollars of it on new pots. How much money is left?

problem: How many Christmas trees are still standing on the farm? The farmer grew 15 trees in each of 8 rows, and families cut down 67 of them in December. Snow lay on the branches.
follow_up_questions: He keeps 13 trees for the town square and sells the rest for 6 dollars each. How much money is that?
He spends 75 dollars of the money on a new saw. What is left?

problem: Ben had 20 tokens at the arcade. He played the racing game 4 times, and each game took 3 tokens. How many tokens did he have left?
follow_up_questions: His aunt gives him 7 more tokens. How many racing games can he play now?

problem: How many tickets were left on Freya's swim card? It started with 20 tickets, and each of her 4 swims used 3 tickets.
follow_up_questions: Her dad adds 7 tickets to the card. How many swims can she have now?

problem: Juan's team filled 3 boxes with 20 pine cones each for a nature project. They gave 15 pine cones to the kindergarten. How many pine cones did they keep?
follow_up_questions: They need 80 pine cones for a wreath. How many more do they need?

problem: How many stamps does the post club have now? Members filled 3 albums with 20 stamps each, then gave away 15 stamps to new members.
follow_up_questions: The club wants 80 stamps for a display. How many more stamps does it need?

problem: What is the weight, in grams, of the gift box Aunt Zara is sending? It holds 6 small jars of jam weighing 85 grams each, and the empty box weighs 45 grams.
follow_up_questions: She takes out 2 jars of jam to keep. How much does the box weigh now?

problem: A box that weighs 45 grams is packed with 6 chocolate bars of 85 grams each. Find the weight of the full box in grams.
follow_up_questions: Then 2 of the chocolate bars are taken out. What does the box weigh now?

problem: How many plasters are left in the school first-aid box? It started the week with 6 packs of 24 plasters, 39 were used on Monday and 28 on Tuesday, and 12 children visited the office in those two days.
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday 3 more packs of the same size arrive. How many plasters are there now?
Over the next 7 days the same number is used each day, and 9 are left at the end. How many were used each day?

problem: The coach began the season with 6 boxes of 24 tennis balls. The team lost 39 balls in the first month and 28 in the second. There are 15 players on the team. How many balls are left?
follow_up_questions: Then 3 more boxes of the same size are delivered. How many balls does the coach have now?
Over the next 7 practices the team loses the same number each time, and 9 balls are left at the end. How many balls were lost at each practice?

problem: The window cleaner owns 2 ladders that are 12 metres long and one ladder that is 9 metres long. Laid end to end, how many metres long would they be?
How long is the train in metres? It has 2 carriages that are 12 metres long each and an engine 9 metres long.
What does Imani pay at the car garage? The mechanic charges 18 dollars an hour and works for 3 hours, and a new battery costs 27 dollars.
follow_up_questions: She also buys 2 wiper blades at 9 dollars each. What is her new total?
She pays with 5 twenty-dollar notes. How much change does she get?
She puts the change in a charity box that already holds 46 dollars. How much is in the box now?

problem: How much is the bill for fixing the Patels' fence? The carpenter works 3 hours at 18 dollars an hour and uses 27 dollars of wood.
follow_up_questions: He also fits 2 new hinges at 9 dollars each. What is the bill now?
Mr. Patel pays with 5 twenty-dollar notes. What is his change?
He adds the change to a jar holding 46 dollars. How much is in the jar now?

problem: The bakery window shows 4 trays of 9 cupcakes and 18 cookies on a plate. How many treats are on show?
follow_up_questions: Omar buys 23 treats from the window. How many are left?
Then the baker adds 3 trays of 5 muffins. How many treats are in the window now?

problem: How many toy cars are on the shop shelf? There are 18 cars standing loose and 4 boxes holding 9 cars each.
follow_up_questions: A boy buys 23 cars. How many are left on the shelf?
The owner puts out 3 more packs of 5 cars. How many cars are on the shelf now?

problem: The ferry crossed the river 9 times on Sunday, carrying 14 passengers each time. A crossing takes 15 minutes, and every passenger pays 3 dollars. What did the ferry earn that day?
follow_up_questions: Fuel cost 48 dollars. How much is left after paying for the fuel?

problem: Each passenger on the mini train pays 3 dollars. The train ran 9 trips at the zoo on Saturday, with 14 riders on every trip, and the track is 40 metres long. How much money did the train collect?
follow_up_questions: The driver's lunch and fuel cost 48 dollars. How much is left?

problem: The school hall has 16 rows of 25 chairs for the spring concert. Parents arrived on 18 coaches with 20 people on each, and every one of them took a seat. How many chairs stayed empty?
How many seats are free on the cruise ship's deck? There are 25 deck chairs in each of 16 rows, and 18 tour groups of 20 people have each sat down.
The toy shop has 3 full boxes of 32 building blocks and a bag of 7 loose blocks. The shop's cat likes to sleep on the counter. How many blocks does the shop have?
follow_up_questions: It sells 2 full boxes to a nursery. How many blocks are left?
Then 4 more loose blocks are found under a shelf. How many blocks does the shop have now?

problem: How many crayons does Mrs. Dubois have? She owns 3 full tins of 32 crayons and a cup with 7 loose crayons. Her favourite colour is turquoise.
follow_up_questions: She gives 2 full tins to the art room. How many crayons does she keep?
Then she buys 4 new crayons for the cup. How many crayons does she have now?

problem: The teachers at the class barbecue eat 12 burgers between them. The pupils sit in 5 groups of 8, and every pupil eats 2 burgers. How many burgers are cooked altogether?
follow_up_questions: The burgers came in packs of 4. How many packs were opened?

problem: Every guest at the street party gets 2 pancakes. There are 5 long tables with 8 guests at each, and the cooks set aside 12 more pancakes for themselves. Find the number of pancakes that must be made.
follow_up_questions: The cook makes them in batches of 4. How many batches does she cook?

problem: Mr. Lopez's class collected bottles for recycling. In the first week they brought in 48, in the second week twice as many, and in the third week 35. How many bottles did they collect?
follow_up_questions: Each bottle earns 5 cents. How many cents did the class earn?
They spend 95 cents on a bag of sweets. How many cents are left?
They split what is left equally between 8 class jars. How many cents go in each jar?

problem: What was the total number of books read in the reading challenge? The Owls read 48, the Foxes read twice as many as the Owls, and the Bears read 35.
follow_up_questions: The library gives 5 cents for every book read. How many cents is that?
The classes spend 95 cents on a bookmark. How many cents are left?
The rest is shared equally among 8 reading corners. How many cents does each get?

problem: The school kitchen has 4 bags of rice weighing 18 kilograms each. If it is shared equally among 8 classes for a cooking day, how many kilograms does each class get? The kitchen also has 25 big pots.
follow_up_questions: Each class also gets 2 kilograms of beans. How many kilograms of food does one class get in all?
What weight of food, in kilograms, is given to all the classes together?

problem: Eight families share the soup kitchen's flour equally. There are 4 sacks of 18 kilograms each, and the kitchen has 12 volunteers. How many kilograms of flour does each family get?
follow_up_questions: Each family also gets 2 kilograms of sugar. How many kilograms does each family take home?
How many kilograms of flour and sugar are given out to all the families?

problem: The pizza delivery rider has 3 bags with 9 pizzas in each, and she has already delivered 16 pizzas. How many pizzas does she still have to deliver?
follow_up_questions: Then she picks up 7 more pizzas from the shop. How many pizzas are in her bags now?

problem: How many boxes are still in the moving van? The van left with 3 stacks of 9 boxes, and the movers have carried 16 boxes into the new house.
follow_up_questions: Next they load 7 boxes from the garage into the van. How many boxes are in the van now?

problem: A dentist saw 18 patients a day for 3 days and then 25 patients a day for 2 days. How many patients did she see in those days?
How many cakes did the bakery sell this week? For 2 days it sold 25 cakes a day, and for 3 other days it sold 18 cakes a day.
The school's spaghetti supper sold 85 plates at 6 dollars each. The food cost 95 dollars. The head teacher served the dessert. How much money did the supper raise after costs?
follow_up_questions: The money is shared equally between 5 school clubs. How much does each club get?
One club adds 17 dollars it already had. How much does that club have now?
